request: I give shop credit to regulars, so for each customer I see the balance, a flag when over their limit, and +500 buttons.
program:
app "Credit" wallet slate
table customer name text, limit money
table entry customer ref customer, amount money, kind pick Took|Paid = Took
each customer sort name as c
  let bal = sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Took) - sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Paid)
  stack card gap 1 tap edit c
    row
      c.name bold grow
      bal bold color if(bal > c.limit, bad, ink)
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(bal / max(c.limit, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill if(bal > c.limit, bad, accent) radius 2
    if bal > c.limit
      "Over the limit" small color bad
    row gap 1
      button "+500" tap add entry customer = c, amount = 500
      button "Paid 500" tap add entry customer = c, amount = 500, kind = Paid
form customer, "Add customer"

request: My kitchen stock gets messy, so I need a search box, a count of ingredients running low, and each one with its expiry date and plus and minus buttons.

state q text = ""

short "ingredients running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)

  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i

    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(ingredient, it.qty * it.price) faint
form ingredient
remind "Check your ingredients" at 9:00 on sat

request: who owes who for shared bills pls
program:
app "Shared bills" users mint
table person name text
table bill what text, amount money, paid ref person
let share = sum(bill.amount) / count(person)
"Total" sum(bill.amount) "," share "each" head
each person as p
  let bal = sum(p.bill.amount) - share
  row card
    p.name bold grow
    if(bal >= 0, "gets back", "owes") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
form person, "Add person"
form bill, "Add bill"
list bill
"Seeing the list live on two phones is not possible; this works on one phone." faint
